name: Muraszemenye (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Muraszemenye (a blue shield with a patriarchal cross, white wings, a castle wall and a green mound) above a yellow scroll inscribed MURASZEMENYE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
